subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paying {Brand} per validated order rather than per click. Since DoorDash announced its largest Reservations expansion yet on May 12, the premium ordering lane has gotten more crowded, and restaurant customer acquisition costs in the US sit between $30 and $80 per new customer. That is exactly the band where cost-per-sale and incrementality decide your real cost per order. We lift-test against organic and direct so cashback and coupon traffic adds net-new orders. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely DoorDash Reservations expansion (sourced) + US restaurant CAC band $30-$80
register_notes: Stage 2 EN food_and_delivery CPS: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely development (DoorDash Reservations largest expansion, May 12 2026, web-verified via Food On Demand) plus web-verified US restaurant CAC band $30-$80 (ChowNow); DoorDash reused from parent, no new brand; MobUpps incrementality/lift-test reference carries no figure; 1 question mark; no sign-off, no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
